event_section.hydrographic_context: Bevano tributary within the Burano-Candigliano system

network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto pubblica idrogrammi sul sistema Burano-Candigliano, incluso Pontedazzo a valle di Cantiano, ma non una sezione sul torrente Bevano compatibile con il ponte ciclopedonale.
network_status.summary_en: The report publishes hydrographs for the Burano-Candigliano system, including Pontedazzo downstream of Cantiano, but no Bevano gauge section compatible with the cycle-pedestrian bridge.

sources.title: Rapporto di evento: maltempo 15, 16 e 17 settembre 2022

curation_note.it: Il punto appartiene allo stesso evento e corso d'acqua del caso IT22.09.04. L'idrogramma di Pontedazzo resta contesto del sistema Burano, non misura del ponte sul Bevano.
curation_note.en: The point belongs to the same event and watercourse as IT22.09.04. The Pontedazzo hydrograph remains Burano-system context, not a measurement at the Bevano bridge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official regional event report

caveats: The official hydrographs are published for different sections of the Burano-Candigliano system.
No stage, discharge or hydrograph is assigned to the Bevano bridge section.
The report graph is not manually digitised into a false-precision numeric peak.
Basin processes do not by themselves prove the bridge-collapse mechanism.
